comparisons.peer_summary: In Q4 FY2024, the Company recorded a $58 million impairment charge for certain in-process R&D in the Data Center segment, related to the 2024 Restructuring Plan.
comparisons.comparison: Both Intels and AMD reported specific non-cash impairment charges directly resulting from their respective 2024 Restructuring Plans within their fiscal year 2024 disclosures. Intel recorded $442 million in 'other non-cash asset impairment charges' included in corporate unallocated expenses, while AMD recorded a $58 million impairment charge for in-process R&D (IPR&D) in its Data Center segment, also related to the 2024 Restructuring Plan. While both companies attribute the charges to the same business event (restructuring), the nature of the assets impaired differs: Intel's charges are broadly categorized as 'other non-cash asset impairment' within corporate unallocated expenses, whereas AMD's is specifically tied to IPR&D assets deemed unrecoverable due to restructuring actions.

sentences.text: We also incurred certain other non-cash asset impairment charges of $442 million as a direct result of the 2024 Restructuring Plan (see "Note 7: Restructuring and Other Charges" within Notes to Consolidated Financial Statements).

During the fourth quarter of fiscal year 2024, the Company determined that the fair value of certain IPR&D recorded within the Data Center segment was not recoverable resulting from actions related to the 2024 Restructuring Plan, and recorded an impairment charge of $58 million within Restructuring charges in the Company's Consolidated Statement of Operations.
